To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

industrial policy is an instrument of the state, which is aimed at creating conditions for the development of a competitive economy, the main goal of which is the development and improvement of the competitiveness of the national economy.

industrial policy is a set of measures to create a favorable institutional framework for the development of the economy; industrial policy should focus on creating a favorable institutional framework, not the creation of specific industries or sectors; the effectiveness of the industrial policy depends on the quality of institutions and the level of economic development of the country.
industrial and competition policies are complementary, but not identical, and that industrial policy should not be a substitute for competition policy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the relationship between competition and industrial policy?
the interaction of industrial and competition policies.
the interaction between industrial and competition policy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interaction of industrial and competition policies is necessary and possible.
there is no clear and unambiguous answer to the question about the interaction between industrial policy and competition policy.
industrial and competition policy should be based on the principle of complementarity, which is based on the fact that industrial and competition policies are mutually reinforcing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the industrial policy is the most effective when it is based on the principle of the state’s indirect intervention in the economy.
industrial policy should be built on the basis of a set of measures aimed at increasing the efficiency of the national industrial sector.
the industrial and competition policy should be built in the context of the New Institutional Economics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
industrial policy should be focused on building the institutional framework for the development of the real sector of the economy.

industrial policy should be based on the principles of the new institutional economics, in particular the principle of property rights, the principle of the market, the principle of competition and the principle of state regulation.
the industrial policy should be focused on building the competitive environment in the country and on creating the conditions for the development of the competitive sectors of the national economy.
